messages:
Priya: Heads-up — sketching an operator-friendly 'hot spillover' evacuation sequence for active-active when a region's GPU pool degrades. Goal: drain hot KV/eviction-critical tenants off degraded nodes with minimal tail-latency spike and obey residency tags.
Matt: +1. what's different from regular evacuation?
Priya: primary diffs: (1) prioritize tenants with non-resident-data first for faster evacuations, (2) short-circuit prefix-KV sync and rely on eventual repair, (3) staged traffic steering with backpressure windows.
Devon: Concern: legal/data residency — we can't move certain tenants out of EU region at all. need a hard deny-list in the operator.
Priya: yep — plan includes residency-policy check before any spillover. deny-list blocks, soft-hold quarantines for consent-required tenants.
Cara: ops runbook idea: step 1 prewarm target node, step 2 set tenant drain mode, step 3 incremental handoff with concurrency cap, step 4 validate token-level latency. Should we include a 'fast-fallback' to run local cold-serving if handoff slow? :thinking: 
Matt: I like a two-phase: prewarm + low-concurrency trial, then ramp. what are the backpressure signals? CPU+GPU queue length? KV-cache-miss spikes?
Priya: backpressure signals: GPU queue > 500ms p99, tail token latency > 300ms, cache-miss-rate delta > 2x. Operator thresholds tunable per-customer.
Devon: can we encode thresholds as CRD? example:
```yaml
apiVersion: infra.redwood/v1
kind: EvacPolicy
metadata:
  name: hot-spillover-eu
spec:
  denyResidency: [eu-only,gov-eu]
  prewarmNodes: 2
  concurrencyCap: 4
  backpressure:
    gpuQueueMsP99: 500
    tokenTailMs: 300
```
Priya: exactly. CRD lets platform teams bake policies. Also add 'consent-escrow' hook for legal approvals.
evac-bot: automated: region eu-west-1 GPUPool degraded -> 12% packet-loss. Incident: https://infra/redwood/inc/8921 :rotating_light: 
Cara: ok operator should prefer same-region targets first, then cross-region only if allowed and capacity insufficient. logs should annotate 'spillover.reason' and 'residency.decision' fields.
Matt: rollout plan? propose dark-launch in dedicated staging for 2 weeks then opt-in for a subset of tenants.
Priya: rollout + metrics: p99 tail tokens, token cost delta, handshake failures. I'll draft RFC with CRD schema and runbook. Assigning to @Matt for staging checklist. :wave:
Matt: on it. I'll add chaos tests for simultaneous multi-region degradation. :hammer_and_wrench:
Priya: thanks — will post RFC link when ready.
